Init clears particles, creates translated settings/plugin/profile/Done controls from own current width/height, profile icon retains translated caption/narration/tooltip. Width initially at least100 but then min with width/2-40, so no positive-width/tiny-window guarantee. Child screen factories receive SAME Home parent.

Before child navigation titleY jumps to target and showTranslators becomes true. On normal later init a fresh credit control receives translator flag. init clears particles only, not all pending/persistent collections; no universal animation reset or native return guarantee claimed.

Home close requests active-config save, reloadIgnoreLists only if connection nonnull, then requests parent. IWailaConfig bridges to Jade.config. Sequential calls do not prove all failure paths reach parent or that persistence/reload succeeds; registry operation internals remain outside scope.

Profile constructor snapshots initial enabled/index and key values for keys matching openConfig category. saver persists ProfileEntry names in options.children, resets native KeyMapping map and saves Minecraft options. canceller restores initial profile selection/enable and captured keys; these callbacks have different scopes.

Enable profiles control mutates root immediately through value callback->save->setter, calls refresh, and disabling resets index0/refreshes key state. This is in-memory live change, not merely pending form data; Root setter alone shows no disk write. Row refresh/disable operates current children list.

Use button requests Jade.useProfile(index), which enables profiles, assigns index, saves root then refreshes key active state. If current screen is ProfileConfigScreen it refreshes that current instance. Setter and disk success are not equivalent; exact configHolder chooses valid enabled nonzero index else root.

Save profile immediately overwrites target from current config: Ctrl bypasses confirmation; otherwise confirm callback calls saveProfile when true and requests captured previous screen either way. saveProfile uses current holder saveTo(destFile), then unconditionally invalidates destination after normal return. Earlier overwrite is not undone by later Cancel.

Confirmation captures current screen and has no current-screen/generation guard. Parent removal clears option child references/visible entries, not a save/cancel transaction. Newer native transition/reinit behavior is not traced; edited rename drafts across confirmation/resize are not guaranteed preserved.

Name starting@ displays translated value while stores original displayed name sentinel. Save preserves original underlying localized name when display unchanged; otherwise sets user text then requests individual profile save. User-entered name is literal appropriately; general menu labels remain translatable.

Reinit retains scroll amount, removes old options, creates new options/model rows, passes old search edit box into constructor, refreshes search/nav and restores scroll. Save checks invalidEntry; valid path options.save->saver->setScreen(parent); invalid path focuses/scolls offending mainWidget. updateSaveState changes invalidEntry and tooltip, not a source proof save button inactive. Invalid-value message is contextual validation, not generic gameplay tutorial.

OptionsList.save iterates all model entries that are OptionValue then diskWriter active config/root. Only afterward Profile saver iterates currently displayed children ProfileEntry names and native key options. This is ordered multi-write flow, not one atomic profile transaction or a promise all filtered names are saved.

Cancel restores initial enabled/index via useProfile if initially enabled, else in-memory disable; then key snapshot Runnable restores key fields and Base returns parent. Existing explicit overwrite is not restored, and disabling branch has no immediate root save shown. Cancel is scoped recovery, not rollback of all disk/config changes.

Visible children are rebuilt from search result; model entries retained separately. Profile saver and refresh use children, while OptionValue save uses all entries. Thus filtering scope matters; no universal hidden-row save/active-state assertion inferred. Search details are shared implementation, not a new independent example.

Write computes temp sibling path after mkdirs; JSON encoding and writing occur inside try, then ATOMIC_MOVE replacement is attempted with non-atomic fallback only on AtomicMoveNotSupportedException. catch(Throwable) logs and cleans temp. No success return flag; mkdirs is before try. Per-file replacement is not cross-profile/options atomicity or concurrent-writer safety.

CachedSupplier publishes nonnull before onUpdate to avoid recursion; callback throw can leave cached value already published, not universal fully-fixed config guarantee. invalidate clears cache; failed overwrite normal return still permits destination invalidation.
